easy_fields.name: DocVQA
creator: Minesh Mathew
Dimosthenis Karatzas
C.V. Jawahar
easy_fields.description: DocVQA is a new dataset for Visual Question Answering (VQA) on document images. It consists of 50,000 questions defined on over 12,000 document images. Answering questions in DocVQA requires models to not only read text but also interpret it within the layout and structure of the document.

G3_collection.reasoning: Section 3.1 explicitly details the data collection process, including the raw data source (UCSF Industry Documents Library), the timeframe (1900-2018), and the selection criteria for document images.
